v1.0.1: Version bump only — frontmatter now includes explicit version field. Content unchanged. Purpose: bump 'Recently updated' sort order for discoverability.

- Initial release of “中文课程论文综述写作与排版导出” skill.
- Supports academic essay writing for Chinese coursework with required formatting (小四, 宋体, double spacing).
- Includes end-to-end workflow: topic selection, reference verification, outline approval, content drafting, and export to docx + pdf.
- Ensures academic integrity by requiring web-verified references (≥20, with English references ≥10, following GB/T 7714-2015 standard).
- Provides detailed instructions for formatting, font settings, and troubleshooting common technical issues.
- Final output includes both docx and PDF files formatted per standard academic requirements, targeting ≥20 pages.
